description: Record that the user planted/sowed something: creates the plant in their catalog if new and the planting in the named bed. Passing variety replaces the variety stored on an existing plant with the same name.

garden.description: Garden name; defaults to the user's first garden.

transplantedAt.description: ISO date the seedling went into the bed (indoor starts).

variety.description: Variety/cultivar, e.g. "Sremski F1". Stored on the plant; replaces the variety of an existing plant with the same name.

name: add_planting
title: Add a planting
